Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:11:1.english: And let [the Tanna] also teach [that] exploitation [is] a perutah - For example, if the purchase was for six perutot.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:11:2.hebrew: אין אונאה לפרוטות - בפחות מאיסר, שהוא מטבע של כסף:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:11:2.english: There is no exploitation concerning perutot - [That is,] for less than an issar, which is a silver coin.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:12:1.hebrew: וגזל בפרוטה - לחייבו קרבן שבועה אם נשבע לשקר, ולהוליכו אחריו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:12:1.english: And robbery [is] with a peruta - To obligate him [to bring] an oath-offering if he swore falsely, and to take it after him [to return it].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:12:2.hebrew: וישיבת הדיינין בפרוטה - למי שיש לו עדים, או שחייב מודה ודוחהו מלשלם, ישבו הדיינין ויכופו אותו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:12:2.english: And the convening of judges is for a peruta - For one who has witnesses, or where the liable party admits [it] and puts him off from paying, the judges convene and compel him [to pay].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:14:1.hebrew: תנא גזל - מכיון דתנא גזל בפרוטה, ש"מ ממונא הוא וכפינן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:14:1.english: He taught robbery - Since he taught robbery of a perutah, learn from this [that] it is [considered] money, and we compel [payment].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:14:2.english: These were necessary for him; robbery - to teach us that he must bring it after him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:14:3.hebrew: אע"ג דזל - בין מציאה להכרזה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:14:3.english: Even though it depreciated - between finding [it] and proclaiming [it].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:18:1.english: Let him teach [second] tithe at a peruta - For less than this, its redemption does not take effect.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:1:1.hebrew: באמצע הקדש ליתא - נהי דבסוף הקדש לא משכחת לה, משום דלאו למזבח חזיא ולא לשקעה בבנין, מיהו בהקדש שני משכחת לה, שמתפיסה תחת אחר וחוזר ופודה אותה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:1:1.english: In intermediate consecration, is it not? - Granted that you do not find it in ultimate consecration, because it is fit neither for the altar nor to be embedded in the [Temple] building; nevertheless, you do find it in a second consecration, where one consecrates it in place of another [item] and then redeems it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:1:2.hebrew: לפי שאינה בסוף הקדש - ומשום הכי אימעיט אמצע הקדש מינה, כדמפרש ואזיל:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:1:2.english: Due to [the fact] that it is not [subject] to ultimate consecration - And because of this, intermediate consecration is excluded from it, as [the Gemara] proceeds to explain.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:1:3.english: (Ultimate consecration, intermediate consecration) We compare [intermediate consecration] to ultimate consecration.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:2:1.english: Just as ultimate consecration - We derive from it that it is excluded from [adding] a fifth.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:2:2.hebrew: אף אמצע הקדש כו' - וסוף הקדש, ודאי בלא מיעוטא דקרא נמי לא שייך ביה חומש, דהא לא פריק ליה. מיהו, אהני מיעוטא דקרא לדמויי ליה אמצע הקדש, דבלאו מיעוטא לא מצית למיגמר אמצע הקדש מסוף הקדש, דהתם משום דלא שייכא ביה חומש הוא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:2:2.english: So too, intermediate consecration, etc. - And [as for] ultimate consecration, certainly even without a scriptural exclusion, [the] one-fifth does not apply to it, since one does not redeem it. However, the scriptural exclusion is effective to compare intermediate consecration to it, for without the exclusion, you could not derive intermediate consecration from ultimate consecration, since there [it is] because [the] one-fifth is not applicable to it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:4:1.hebrew: כדאמר רבא כו' - כלומר, בהדיא אימעיט אמצע הקדש מינה, כדאמר רבא בסדר יומא (דף לד.):
Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:4:1.english: As Rava says, etc. - That is to say, the intermediate [stage of] consecration is explicitly excluded from it, as Rava says in Seder Yoma (34a).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:4:2.hebrew: העולה - דכתיב גבי סדר המערכה: "ובער עליה הכהן עצים בבקר בבקר וערך עליה העולה". ה' יתירה דריש, שתהא היא ראשונה, שלא יהא הקטר קודם לתמיד של שחר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:4:2.english: The burnt-offering - As it is written regarding the arrangement of the altar pyre: "And the priest shall burn wood upon it every morning, and he shall arrange the burnt-offering upon it." He expounds the superfluous [letter] heh [to teach] that it should be the first [offering], so that no burning [of another offering] should precede the daily morning burnt-offering.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:5:1.hebrew: הקדשו פדוי - אע"פ שלא שם דמים קצובין, דקיימא לן הקדש שוה מנה שחיללו על שוה פרוטה מחולל, ושרי לאיתהנויי מיניה. ומיהו יד הקדש על העליונה, שאם דמים הללו יתירים על דמי ההקדש, קנה הקדש; ואם הקדש יתר עליהם, ישלים על כרחו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:5:1.english: His consecrated [property] is redeemed - Even though he did not assess a fixed value, since we hold [that] consecrated [property] worth a maneh that one redeemed for [something] worth a perutah is redeemed, and it is permitted to derive benefit from it. However, the [Temple] treasury has the upper hand: for if this value exceeds the value of the consecrated [property], the [Temple] treasury acquires [it]; and if the consecrated [property] exceeds it, he must make up [the difference] against his will.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:6:1.hebrew: טלית זו בחמש סלעים כו' הקדשו פדוי - אע"פ שאינו שוה, ולא תימא הואיל ושם לה דמים ואינה שוה כמה שאמר אין דבריו כלום, אלא הקדש פדוי והוא ישלים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:6:1.english: This garment [valued] at five sela, etc., his consecrated [property] is redeemed - Even though it is not worth [that amount] — and do not say [that] since he assessed a monetary value for it and it is not worth as much as he said, his words are nothing — rather, the consecrated [property] is redeemed, and he must make up [the difference].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:6:2.english: For a second consecration - If he went back and redeemed this [one].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:7:1.hebrew: האונאה ארבעה כסף - למקח סלע, וכדאמרן, דהוה ליה שתות:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:7:1.english: The exploitation is four silver [ma'ah] - For a purchase of a sela, and as we said [earlier], for it is a sixth [of a sela].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:7:2.hebrew: והטענה שתי כסף - שאין שבועת דיינין על הטענה פחותה משתי מעות כסף, שיטענו "שוה שתי כסף יש לי בידך", וזה יודה לו מהם שוה פרוטה ויכפור השאר, או יודה הכל ויכפור פרוטה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:7:2.english: And the claim [is] two silver [ma'ah] - For there is no judges' oath on a claim [of] less than two silver ma'ah: that [the plaintiff] claims [from] him, "[Something] worth two silver [ma'ah] of mine is in your possession," and this [defendant] admits to him [owing] the value of a perutah of them and denies the rest, or admits all [the rest] and denies a perutah.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:7:3.hebrew: וההודאה שוה פרוטה - כדפרשינן, להיות הודאה במקצת ויתחייב שבועה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:7:3.english: And the admission [is] the value of a peruta - As we explained, to be a partial admission so that he becomes obligated [to take] an oath.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:8:1.hebrew: המוצא שוה פרוטה כו' - אבל בציר מהכי לא, כדאמרן (לעיל בבא מציעא ד' כז.): "מאשר תאבד ממנו" — פרט לאבידה שאין בה שוה פרוטה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:8:1.english: One who finds the value of a peruta, etc. - But less than this, [he is] not [obligated to proclaim it], as we said (above, Bava Metzia 27a): from [the verse], "which is lost by him" — excluding a lost item that does not have the value of a peruta.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:8:2.hebrew: ויוליכנו אחריו - אם הודה שנשבע לשקר, דלא הויא ליה כפרה עד שיחזירנו לידו ממש ולא לשלוחו, כדכתיב (במדבר ה׳:ז׳) ונתן לאשר אשם לו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 55a:8:2.english: And he must take [it] after him - If he confessed that he swore falsely, for he has no atonement until he returns it into his actual hand, and not to his agent, as it is written (Numbers 5:7), "And he shall give [it] to the one whom he wronged."

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 55a:13:1.hebrew: ותנא דידן מאי טעמא לא תני ישיבת הדיינין - תימה: לישני דאית ליה דרב קטינא, דנזקקין אפילו לפחות משוה פרוטה, דבסמוך אמר דלוי דתני ישיבת הדיינין לא איצטריך אלא לאפוקי דרב קטינא. וי"ל דמסקינן דבתחילת דין מודה רב קטינא דבעינן שוה פרוטה; להכי פריך: "ותנא דידן ליתני ישיבת הדיינין", דמשמע תחילת ישיבה? וכי משני אלוי לאפוקי דרב קטינא, (סבר דרב קטינא אית ליה דנזקקין אפילו להתחיל ולישב):
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 55a:13:1.english: And the tanna of our [mishna], what is the reason he does not teach the convening of judges - It is astonishing: let [the Gemara] answer that [our tanna] holds [like] Rav Ketina, that [judges] attend [to a case] even for less than the value of a perutah, for shortly [below, the Gemara] says that Levi, who teaches "convening of judges," only needed [to teach it] to exclude [the view of] Rav Ketina. And one can answer that we conclude [below] that at the beginning of a judgment, Rav Ketina agrees that we require the value of a perutah; therefore [the Gemara] asks: "And let the tanna of our [mishna] teach 'convening of judges,'" which implies the beginning of the [court's] session? And when [the Gemara] answers regarding Levi, "[he taught it] to exclude Rav Ketina," ([the Gemara there] thought that Rav Ketina holds that [judges] attend [to a case] even to begin and convene [a session]).

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 55a:18:1.hebrew: [לעיל] כמאן דאמר אין בחומשו - ולמ"ד "אין בו" קשה, וכן נמי איתותב לעיל:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 55a:18:1.english: [Above] "In accordance with the one who says: Its one-fifth does not [have the value of a peruta]" - And according to the one who says [that the verse excludes second tithe that] "does not have [the value of a peruta]," it is difficult [to resolve]; and indeed, he was also refuted above.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 55a:3:1.hebrew: נדמייה לתחילת הקדש - וא"ת: אם כן, קרא למה לי? אי למעוטי סוף הקדש — הא אין חומש שייך בו, כיון שאין נפדה עוד! וי"ל: כגון שלקח אבנים כדי לשקען בבנין, ונמלך עליהם לפדותם, ומקרי אפ"ה סוף הקדש, כיון שמתחילה היה דעתו לשקען; אי נמי, כגון שנפל הבנין ורוצה לפדות האבנים. אי נמי, הכי פריך: מנ"ל למעוטי אמצע הקדש? דלמא קרא לא אתא אלא למעוטי אין כולה לשמים:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 55a:3:1.english: Let us liken it to initial consecration - And if you ask: If so [that intermediate consecration is likened to initial consecration], why do I need the verse? If [it comes] to exclude ultimate consecration — surely a fifth is not applicable to it, since it is not redeemed again! And one can answer: [It is needed for a case] such as where one took stones in order to set them into the building, and changed his mind about them to redeem them, and it is nevertheless called ultimate consecration, since originally his intention was to set them in; alternatively, [a case] such as where the building collapsed and he wants to redeem the stones. Alternatively, this is what he is asking: From where do we know to exclude intermediate consecration? Perhaps the verse only comes to exclude [that which is] not entirely for Heaven.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 55a:4:1.hebrew: העולה עולה ראשונה - הכתובה ראשונה בקרבנות בפרשת פינחס, והיינו תמיד של שחר; וכן פי' רש"י פרק תמיד נשחט (פסחים דף נח: ושם). אי נמי: ראשונה שהקריבו ישראל במדבר, [למאן] דאמר דעולת תמיד הואי. אי נמי: ראשונה לחינוך המזבח, כדאמר בהתכלת (מנחות דף מט. ושם): "אין מחנכין את המזבח אלא בתמיד השחר":
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 55a:4:1.english: "The burnt-offering" — the first burnt-offering - [That is, the burnt-offering] written first among the offerings in Parashat Pinchas, and this is the morning daily offering; and so Rashi explained in chapter Tamid Nishchat (Pesachim 58b and there). Alternatively, [it means] the first [burnt-offering] that Israel offered in the wilderness, according to the one who says that it was a daily burnt-offering. Alternatively, [it means] the first [offering] for the dedication of the altar, as it says in [chapter] Hatekhelet (Menachot 49a and there): "We do not dedicate the altar except with the morning daily offering."

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 55a:5:1.hebrew: פרה זו תחת פרה של הקדש הקדשו פדוי - וא"ת: והכתיב (ויקרא כ״ז:י׳) "והיה הוא ותמורתו יהיה קדש"! י"ל דהכא מיירי בקדשי בדק הבית, ואפילו בתמימים, דאמר בריש תמורה (ד' ה:): המתפיס תמימים לבדק הבית, אע"פ שעובר בלא תעשה, מה שעשה עשוי. והא דאמרי' התם: "כל הראוי לגבי המזבח אינו יוצא מידי מזבח לעולם" — היינו דכשפודין אותו מוכרין אותו לצרכי עולות. אי נמי, מיירי אפילו בקדשי מזבח, וכגון שקדם המום להקדש, דאינו עושה תמורה. אבל אין לפרש דמיירי אפילו קדם הקדשו למומו וכגון דידו אקודש — דלא עביד תמורה אלא היכא דאנח ידו אחולין — ד"פרה זו תחת פרה של הקדש" משמע דידו אחולין:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 55a:5:1.english: "[If one said,] 'This cow is in place of that cow, which belongs to the Temple treasury,' his consecrated property is redeemed" - And if you ask: Is it not written (Leviticus 27:10), "Then both it and its substitute shall be holy" [so how can the original be redeemed rather than both remaining consecrated]? One can answer that here [the baraita] is dealing with [animals] consecrated for Temple upkeep, and even with unblemished [animals], as it states at the beginning of [Tractate] Temurah (5b): One who consecrates unblemished [animals] for Temple upkeep, even though he transgresses a negative commandment, what he has done is effective [and such animals do not effect temurah]. And as for that which they say there, "Anything fit for the altar never leaves the status of the altar" — that means that when one redeems it, they sell it for the purpose of burnt offerings [but it is still redeemable]. Alternatively, [the baraita] is dealing even with [animals] consecrated for the altar, and [specifically] in a case where the blemish preceded the consecration, for [such an animal] does not effect temurah. However, one cannot explain that [the baraita] is dealing even [with a case where] its consecration preceded its blemish, and in a case where his hand is on the consecrated [animal] — for [an animal] does not effect temurah unless he places his hand on the non-sacred [animal] — because [the wording] "this cow is in place of that cow, which belongs to the Temple treasury" implies that his hand is on the non-sacred [animal]:

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 55a:6:1.hebrew: טלית זו בחמש סלעים הקדשו פדוי - הכא לא גרסינן "יד הקדש על העליונה", דכיון שנתכוון לחלל הקדש, אפילו שוה הרבה על דבר מועט מחולל, כדקאמר שמואל לקמן. אבל ברישא, שלא הזכיר שום שוה, לא היה בדעתו לקנות ההקדש אלא לחללו שוה בשוה; לכך ישלים, ואם הותיר — יד הקדש על העליונה. ולכך לא עירב לשנות הבבות יחד:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 55a:6:1.english: "This garment [valued] at five sela... his consecrated [property] is redeemed" - Here we do not read [in the text] "the Temple treasury has the upper hand," because since he intended to deconsecrate consecrated property, even [something] worth a great deal is deconsecrated onto a thing of little value, as Shmuel states later. However, in the first clause, where he did not mention any value, it was not his intention to acquire the consecrated property [at a fixed price], rather to deconsecrate it value for value; therefore he must make up [any shortfall], and if it exceeded [in value], the Temple treasury has the upper hand. And therefore [the tanna] did not combine them to teach the [two] clauses together.
